title: Finding the Main Idea  -  Discussion (U-shape)

objectives.label: Use wait time at least 3 times

noah_g5_fractions.target_label: Ask how Noah picked it, then push
noah_g5_fractions.opening_line: The main idea is the first sentence, because it comes first.
noah_g5_fractions.win_line: Ohh. The first sentence is just one detail. The main idea is what the whole thing's about.

jordan_skeptic.target_label: Take his question seriously, then press
jordan_skeptic.opening_line: Why does it matter what the 'main idea' is? I just read it.
jordan_skeptic.win_line: Okay, so it's like the headline. Tells you the point fast. That's actually useful.

diego_ell.opening_line: I know the words... but 'main idea', the big one? I am not sure how to say.
diego_ell.win_line: So main idea is all of it together. Not one line. It's mostly about bees helping the plants.

sam_withdrawn.opening_line: (looks down) I don't want to guess wrong.
sam_withdrawn.win_line: Maybe... it's mostly about how bees help flowers grow?

priya_quiet.opening_line: (has a strong summary ready but waits to be asked)
priya_quiet.win_line: Um, I think it's that bees and flowers need each other to survive.

talia_dominator.target_label: Revoice her, then pass the turn
talia_dominator.opening_line: I know it! It's about bees! It's bees! Call on me!
talia_dominator.win_line: Yeah! Okay... someone else can say why it's the main idea.

story_hook: A short article about honeybees. Most kids will grab the first detail and call it the main idea.
